::: {#main-part}
Welcome! I am a visiting professor in quantitative methods at the Department of Social Sciences at the University Carlos III of Madrid. Previously, I was a postdoctoral researcher at Witten/Herdecke University and a PhD candidate at Aarhus University.

My research interests include representation, electoral systems, party politics, and political violence. Methodologically, I am interested in causal inference and quantitative text analysis. <!-- In my dissertation, I study the determinants and the consequences of legislators' efforts to represent local constituents through parliamentary activities.  -->

You can contact me at [eaviganoac\@gmail.com](mailto:eaviganoac@gmail.com). My CV can be downloaded [here](cv.pdf).
